scientific.integrity: The proof is an explicit semialgebraic construction. It uses the published cornet/slit-disk equiregularity and section-transfer results, then verifies directly that a closed-form deformation retract preserves the graph closure for every integer parameter.
limitations: Only first-homology complexity and finite free fundamental-group rank are prescribed.
The construction is in ambient dimension four; no corresponding minimal-dimension theorem is claimed.
No classification of all CAD-cell closure homotopy types is asserted.

title: Unbounded first Betti number for closures of bounded CAD cells in \(\mathbf R^4\)
